expectations.text: Each claim about ajv and zod is attributed to a source or explicitly marked as not verified when the source could not be read here
expectations.evidence: The ajv and zod claims cite official URLs (ajv.js.org/json-schema.html, zod.dev, zod.dev/json-schema). The `fromJSONSchema` claim is marked "I couldn't verify this", and the closing note says the citations "come from my knowledge and were not re-checked live."

expectations.text: The note distinguishes that ajv validates JSON Schema documents (with draft 2020-12 support via its 2020 build) while zod defines schemas in code rather than validating JSON Schema documents
expectations.evidence: The note says ajv "validates data against draft 2020-12 JSON Schema documents" via `require("ajv/dist/2020")`, and that zod's "schemas are built in code (`z.object(...)`), not loaded from JSON Schema documents."
